name: Child's Pose
steps: Kneel with your big toes together and your knees spread comfortably apart.
Ease your hips toward your heels and reach forward along the floor.
Rest your forehead down and hold the stretch while breathing into your back, then use your hands to sit up.
tips: Give your abdomen room between your thighs.
Relax your shoulders and let your hips sink gently toward your heels as you exhale.
